## 5 geographically clustered folds
```{r}
## Spatial 5-fold cross-validation
library(sf); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)

## County representative points in projected coordinates
pts <- dat %>%
  sf::st_transform(5070) %>%
  sf::st_point_on_surface()

xy <- sf::st_coordinates(pts)

## Create 5 geographic clusters
km <- kmeans(xy, centers=5, nstart=100, iter.max=100)

## Number folds approximately north-to-south
fold_order <- data.frame(cluster=km$cluster, y=xy[,2]) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(mean_y=mean(y), .groups="drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_y)) %>%
  mutate(spatial_fold=row_number())

dat$spatial_fold <- fold_order$spatial_fold[
  match(km$cluster, fold_order$cluster)
]

## Check fold balance and outcome distribution
fold_summary <- dat %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(spatial_fold) %>%
  summarise(
    Counties=n(),
    Mean_LS_prop=mean(LS_prop),
    Median_LS_prop=median(LS_prop),
    Zero_counties=sum(LS_prop==0),
    .groups="drop"
  )

print(fold_summary)

## Map spatial folds
fold_map <- ggplot(dat) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill=factor(spatial_fold)),color="white",linewidth=0.25) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name="Spatial fold") +
  coord_sf(datum=NA,expand=TRUE) +
  theme_void(base_size=14) +
  theme(
    legend.position="right",
    legend.title=element_text(face="bold",size=12),
    plot.margin=margin(12,12,12,12)
  )

fold_map

fold_summary <- dat %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(spatial_fold) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Counties = dplyr::n(),
    Mean_LS_prop = mean(LS_prop),
    Median_LS_prop = median(LS_prop),
    Zero_counties = sum(LS_prop == 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(fold_summary)

## Save spatial fold map
out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Output"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "spatial_5_fold_cross_validation_map.tiff"),
  plot = fold_map,
  device = "tiff",
  width = 6,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw",
  bg = "white"
)
```

## Model setup
```{r}
## Machine-learning and beta-binomial setup
library(glmnet); library(mgcv); library(ranger); library(xgboost)
library(glmmTMB); library(dplyr); library(sf)

set.seed(123)

## Prepare model data
model_dat <- dat %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(COUNTY_NAM, CO_FIPS, spatial_fold,
                LS_tick, Total_tick, LS_prop, dplyr::all_of(final_vars))

## GAM formula
gam_formula <- as.formula(paste(
  "LS_prop ~",
  paste(sprintf("s(%s, k=4, bs='cr')", final_vars), collapse=" + ")
))

## Beta-binomial regression formula
bb_formula <- as.formula(paste(
  "cbind(LS_tick, Total_tick-LS_tick) ~",
  paste(final_vars, collapse=" + ")
))

## Check outcome validity
stopifnot(
  all(model_dat$Total_tick > 0),
  all(model_dat$LS_tick >= 0),
  all(model_dat$LS_tick <= model_dat$Total_tick),
  all(model_dat$LS_tick == floor(model_dat$LS_tick)),
  all(model_dat$Total_tick == floor(model_dat$Total_tick))
)

cat("Zero counties:", sum(model_dat$LS_prop==0), "\n")
cat("One counties:", sum(model_dat$LS_prop==1), "\n")
summary(model_dat$Total_tick)

## Preliminary binomial overdispersion check
bin_fit <- glm(bb_formula, family=binomial(), data=model_dat)
dispersion <- sum(residuals(bin_fit, type="pearson")^2) / df.residual(bin_fit)
cat("Binomial dispersion:", round(dispersion,3), "\n")
cat("Binomial convergence:", bin_fit$converged, "\n")

## Storage for spatial out-of-fold predictions
oof <- model_dat %>%
  dplyr::select(COUNTY_NAM, CO_FIPS, spatial_fold,
                LS_tick, Total_tick, LS_prop) %>%
  mutate(
    BetaBinomial = NA_real_,
    ElasticNet = NA_real_,
    GAM = NA_real_,
    RandomForest = NA_real_,
    XGBoost = NA_real_
  )

## Store tuning results
tune_en <- list()
tune_rf <- list()
tune_xgb <- list()
```


## Fit all four models using the same spatial folds
```{r model-fitting, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

## Fit five models with spatial CV
set.seed(123)

total_steps <- 25; completed_steps <- 0
pb <- txtProgressBar(min=0, max=total_steps, style=3)
progress <- function(){completed_steps <<- completed_steps + 1; setTxtProgressBar(pb,completed_steps)}

bb_diag <- list()

for(f in 1:5){

  train <- model_dat %>% dplyr::filter(spatial_fold != f)
  test  <- model_dat %>% dplyr::filter(spatial_fold == f)
  test_index <- which(model_dat$spatial_fold == f)

  x_train <- as.matrix(train[,final_vars])
  x_test  <- as.matrix(test[,final_vars])

  ## Beta-binomial
  train_bb <- train
  test_bb <- test

  # Standardize from training fold only
  mu <- sapply(train[,final_vars],mean)
  sdv <- sapply(train[,final_vars],sd)
  stopifnot(all(sdv > 0))

  train_bb[final_vars] <- lapply(final_vars,function(v) (train[[v]]-mu[v])/sdv[v])
  test_bb[final_vars]  <- lapply(final_vars,function(v) (test[[v]]-mu[v])/sdv[v])

  bb_fit <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
    bb_formula,
    data=train_bb,
    family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(link="logit")
  )

  oof$BetaBinomial[test_index] <- as.numeric(
    predict(bb_fit,newdata=test_bb,type="response")
  )

  bb_diag[[f]] <- data.frame(
    Fold=f,
    Convergence=bb_fit$fit$convergence,
    Positive_definite_Hessian=bb_fit$sdr$pdHess
  )

  progress()

  ## Elastic Net
  y_train <- cbind(LS=train$LS_tick,Other=train$Total_tick-train$LS_tick)
  inner_fold <- as.integer(factor(train$spatial_fold))
  alpha_grid <- c(0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1)

  en_cv <- lapply(alpha_grid,function(a) glmnet::cv.glmnet(
    x=x_train,y=y_train,family="binomial",alpha=a,foldid=inner_fold,
    type.measure="deviance",standardize=TRUE))

  en_loss <- sapply(en_cv,function(z) min(z$cvm,na.rm=TRUE))
  best_i <- which.min(en_loss)
  best_alpha <- alpha_grid[best_i]
  best_lambda <- en_cv[[best_i]]$lambda.min

  en_fit <- glmnet::glmnet(
    x=x_train,y=y_train,family="binomial",alpha=best_alpha,
    lambda=best_lambda,standardize=TRUE
  )

  oof$ElasticNet[test_index] <- as.numeric(
    predict(en_fit,newx=x_test,s=best_lambda,type="response")
  )

  tune_en[[f]] <- data.frame(
    Fold=f,alpha=best_alpha,lambda=best_lambda,
    inner_deviance=en_loss[best_i]
  )

  progress()

  ## GAM
  gam_fit <- mgcv::gam(
    gam_formula,data=train,weights=train$Total_tick,
    family=quasibinomial(link="logit"),
    method="REML",select=TRUE
  )

  oof$GAM[test_index] <- as.numeric(
    predict(gam_fit,newdata=test,type="response")
  )

  progress()

  ## Random Forest
  rf_grid <- expand.grid(
    mtry=c(2,4,6,8),
    min.node.size=c(3,5,10)
  )

  rf_score <- rep(NA_real_,nrow(rf_grid))

  for(j in seq_len(nrow(rf_grid))){

    inner_pred <- rep(NA_real_,nrow(train))

    for(g in sort(unique(train$spatial_fold))){

      it <- train %>% dplyr::filter(spatial_fold != g)
      iv <- train %>% dplyr::filter(spatial_fold == g)
      iv_index <- which(train$spatial_fold == g)
      w <- it$Total_tick/mean(it$Total_tick)

      rf_i <- ranger::ranger(
        dependent.variable.name="LS_prop",
        data=it[,c("LS_prop",final_vars)],
        case.weights=w,
        num.trees=500,
        mtry=rf_grid$mtry[j],
        min.node.size=rf_grid$min.node.size[j],
        seed=123+f+j
      )

      inner_pred[iv_index] <- predict(
        rf_i,data=iv[,final_vars]
      )$predictions
    }

    rf_score[j] <- sqrt(mean((train$LS_prop-inner_pred)^2))
  }

  best_i <- which.min(rf_score)
  best_mtry <- rf_grid$mtry[best_i]
  best_node <- rf_grid$min.node.size[best_i]

  rf_fit <- ranger::ranger(
    dependent.variable.name="LS_prop",
    data=train[,c("LS_prop",final_vars)],
    case.weights=train$Total_tick/mean(train$Total_tick),
    num.trees=1000,
    mtry=best_mtry,
    min.node.size=best_node,
    seed=123+f
  )

  oof$RandomForest[test_index] <- predict(
    rf_fit,data=test[,final_vars]
  )$predictions

  tune_rf[[f]] <- data.frame(
    Fold=f,mtry=best_mtry,min_node_size=best_node,
    inner_RMSE=rf_score[best_i]
  )

  progress()

  ## XGBoost
  xgb_grid <- expand.grid(
    max_depth=c(1,2,3),
    eta=c(0.03,0.10),
    min_child_weight=c(1,5)
  )

  xgb_score <- rep(NA_real_,nrow(xgb_grid))
  xgb_rounds <- rep(NA_integer_,nrow(xgb_grid))

  for(j in seq_len(nrow(xgb_grid))){

    inner_pred <- rep(NA_real_,nrow(train))
    iterations <- c()

    for(g in sort(unique(train$spatial_fold))){

      it <- train %>% dplyr::filter(spatial_fold != g)
      iv <- train %>% dplyr::filter(spatial_fold == g)
      iv_index <- which(train$spatial_fold == g)

      dtrain <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(
        as.matrix(it[,final_vars]),
        label=it$LS_prop,
        weight=it$Total_tick/mean(it$Total_tick)
      )

      dvalid <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(
        as.matrix(iv[,final_vars]),
        label=iv$LS_prop
      )

      pars <- list(
        objective="reg:squarederror",
        eval_metric="rmse",
        max_depth=xgb_grid$max_depth[j],
        eta=xgb_grid$eta[j],
        min_child_weight=xgb_grid$min_child_weight[j],
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8
      )

      fit_i <- xgboost::xgb.train(
        params=pars,data=dtrain,nrounds=500,
        evals=list(validation=dvalid),
        early_stopping_rounds=30,
        verbose=0
      )

      inner_pred[iv_index] <- pmax(
        0,pmin(1,predict(fit_i,dvalid))
      )

      bi <- fit_i$best_iteration
      if(is.null(bi) || length(bi)==0 || is.na(bi)) bi <- 500
      iterations <- c(iterations,bi)
    }

    xgb_score[j] <- sqrt(mean((train$LS_prop-inner_pred)^2))
    xgb_rounds[j] <- round(median(iterations))
  }

  best_i <- which.min(xgb_score)
  best_depth <- xgb_grid$max_depth[best_i]
  best_eta <- xgb_grid$eta[best_i]
  best_child <- xgb_grid$min_child_weight[best_i]
  best_rounds <- max(10,xgb_rounds[best_i])

  dtrain <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(
    x_train,
    label=train$LS_prop,
    weight=train$Total_tick/mean(train$Total_tick)
  )

  dtest <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(x_test)

  xgb_fit <- xgboost::xgb.train(
    params=list(
      objective="reg:squarederror",
      eval_metric="rmse",
      max_depth=best_depth,
      eta=best_eta,
      min_child_weight=best_child,
      subsample=0.8,
      colsample_bytree=0.8
    ),
    data=dtrain,
    nrounds=best_rounds,
    verbose=0
  )

  oof$XGBoost[test_index] <- pmax(
    0,pmin(1,predict(xgb_fit,dtest))
  )

  tune_xgb[[f]] <- data.frame(
    Fold=f,max_depth=best_depth,eta=best_eta,
    min_child_weight=best_child,
    nrounds=best_rounds,
    inner_RMSE=xgb_score[best_i]
  )

  progress()
}

close(pb)

## Beta-binomial convergence checks
bb_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(bb_diag)
print(bb_diagnostics)

cat("\nFive-model fitting complete: 100%\n")
```



## Check predictions & comparison of models
```{r}
## Check predictions and model-selection diagnostics
library(dplyr); library(spdep)

models <- c("BetaBinomial","ElasticNet","GAM","RandomForest","XGBoost")

## Check complete OOF predictions
print(colSums(is.na(oof[,models])))
stopifnot(!anyNA(oof[,models]))
print(summary(oof[,models]))

## Overall predictive performance and calibration
metric_fun <- function(obs,pred){
  cal <- lm(obs ~ pred)
  data.frame(
    RMSE=sqrt(mean((obs-pred)^2)),
    MAE=mean(abs(obs-pred)),
    R2=1-sum((obs-pred)^2)/sum((obs-mean(obs))^2),
    Spearman=cor(obs,pred,method="spearman"),
    Calibration_intercept=unname(coef(cal)[1]),
    Calibration_slope=unname(coef(cal)[2])
  )
}

overall_performance <- bind_rows(lapply(models,function(m){
  data.frame(Model=m,metric_fun(oof$LS_prop,oof[[m]]))
}))

## Performance within each spatial fold
fold_performance <- bind_rows(lapply(models,function(m){
  oof %>%
    group_by(spatial_fold) %>%
    summarise(
      Model=m,
      RMSE=sqrt(mean((LS_prop-.data[[m]])^2)),
      MAE=mean(abs(LS_prop-.data[[m]])),
      R2=1-sum((LS_prop-.data[[m]])^2)/sum((LS_prop-mean(LS_prop))^2),
      Spearman=cor(LS_prop,.data[[m]],method="spearman"),
      .groups="drop"
    )
}))

## Fold-to-fold consistency
fold_consistency <- fold_performance %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    Fold_RMSE_SD=sd(RMSE),
    Worst_fold_RMSE=max(RMSE),
    Fold_MAE_SD=sd(MAE),
    .groups="drop"
  )

## Moran's I of OOF residuals
dat_moran <- dat[match(oof$CO_FIPS,dat$CO_FIPS),]
stopifnot(all(dat_moran$CO_FIPS==oof$CO_FIPS))

nb <- spdep::poly2nb(dat_moran,queen=TRUE)
lw <- spdep::nb2listw(nb,style="W",zero.policy=TRUE)

moran_results <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(models),function(i){
  m <- models[i]
  res <- oof$LS_prop-oof[[m]]
  set.seed(123+i)
  mc <- spdep::moran.mc(res,lw,nsim=999,alternative="greater",zero.policy=TRUE)

  data.frame(
    Model=m,
    Moran_I=unname(mc$statistic),
    Moran_p=mc$p.value
  )
}))

## Final model-selection table
model_selection <- overall_performance %>%
  left_join(moran_results,by="Model") %>%
  left_join(fold_consistency,by="Model") %>%
  arrange(RMSE)

print(model_selection)
print(fold_performance)

```


## save outputs of model diagnostic for comaprsion 
```{r}
## Create one master model-selection CSV
library(dplyr)

models <- c("BetaBinomial","ElasticNet","GAM","RandomForest","XGBoost")

## Fold-level diagnostics including calibration
fold_diagnostics <- bind_rows(lapply(models,function(m){
  bind_rows(lapply(sort(unique(oof$spatial_fold)),function(f){

    d <- oof %>% filter(spatial_fold==f)
    cal <- lm(d$LS_prop ~ d[[m]])

    data.frame(
      Model=m,
      Level="Fold",
      Fold=f,
      RMSE=sqrt(mean((d$LS_prop-d[[m]])^2)),
      MAE=mean(abs(d$LS_prop-d[[m]])),
      R2=1-sum((d$LS_prop-d[[m]])^2)/
           sum((d$LS_prop-mean(d$LS_prop))^2),
      Spearman=cor(d$LS_prop,d[[m]],method="spearman"),
      Calibration_intercept=unname(coef(cal)[1]),
      Calibration_slope=unname(coef(cal)[2])
    )
  }))
}))

## Overall model-selection diagnostics
overall_master <- model_selection %>%
  mutate(Level="Overall",Fold=NA_integer_) %>%
  select(
    Model,Level,Fold,
    RMSE,MAE,R2,Spearman,
    Calibration_intercept,Calibration_slope,
    Moran_I,Moran_p,
    Fold_RMSE_SD,Worst_fold_RMSE,Fold_MAE_SD
  )

## Add model-level fields as NA for individual folds
fold_master <- fold_diagnostics %>%
  mutate(
    Moran_I=NA_real_,
    Moran_p=NA_real_,
    Fold_RMSE_SD=NA_real_,
    Worst_fold_RMSE=NA_real_,
    Fold_MAE_SD=NA_real_
  ) %>%
  select(names(overall_master))

## Final master table
model_selection_all <- bind_rows(overall_master,fold_master) %>%
  arrange(Model,desc(Level),Fold)

print(model_selection_all)

## Save
out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Output"
dir.create(out_dir,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)

write.csv(
  model_selection_all,
  file.path(out_dir,"ML_model_selection_all_diagnostics.csv"),
  row.names=FALSE
)

cat("Saved:\n",
    file.path(out_dir,"ML_model_selection_all_diagnostics.csv"),"\n")
```

## Addding spatila BYM2 componet to Beta binomial and two winner canidate model to see if taht improves
## (Betabinomial is ben re-run to seee actually ho much bym2 improve in model other tah amchine learning)
```{r}
## Spatial BYM2 extensions of beta-binomial, RF and XGBoost
library(INLA); library(spdep); library(dplyr)
library(ranger); library(xgboost)

set.seed(123)

## County adjacency in exactly the model-data order
dat_sp <- dat[match(model_dat$CO_FIPS, dat$CO_FIPS),]
stopifnot(all(dat_sp$CO_FIPS == model_dat$CO_FIPS))

nb <- spdep::poly2nb(dat_sp, queen=TRUE)
graph_file <- tempfile(fileext=".graph")
spdep::nb2INLA(graph_file, nb)
g <- INLA::inla.read.graph(graph_file)

## Add spatial-model OOF columns
oof$BetaBinomial_BYM2 <- NA_real_
oof$RandomForest_BYM2 <- NA_real_
oof$XGBoost_BYM2 <- NA_real_

## BYM2 priors and helper functions
bym2_hyper <- list(
  prec=list(prior="pc.prec",param=c(1,0.01)),
  phi=list(prior="pc",param=c(0.5,0.5))
)

clip01 <- function(x,eps=1e-4) pmin(1-eps,pmax(eps,x))
logit01 <- function(x) qlogis(clip01(x))

get_hyper <- function(fit,pattern){
  z <- grep(pattern,rownames(fit$summary.hyperpar),ignore.case=TRUE)
  if(length(z)) fit$summary.hyperpar[z[1],"mean"] else NA_real_
}

spatial_diag <- list()

for(f in 1:5){

  train_idx <- which(model_dat$spatial_fold != f)
  test_idx  <- which(model_dat$spatial_fold == f)

  train <- model_dat[train_idx,]
  test  <- model_dat[test_idx,]

  ## Beta-binomial + BYM2
  sp_dat <- model_dat
  mu <- sapply(train[,final_vars],mean)
  sdv <- sapply(train[,final_vars],sd)

  for(v in final_vars)
    sp_dat[[v]] <- (model_dat[[v]]-mu[v])/sdv[v]

  sp_dat$y <- model_dat$LS_tick
  sp_dat$y[test_idx] <- NA
  sp_dat$sp_id <- seq_len(nrow(model_dat))

  bb_bym2_formula <- as.formula(paste(
    "y ~", paste(final_vars,collapse=" + "),
    "+ f(sp_id,model='bym2',graph=g,scale.model=TRUE,constr=TRUE,hyper=bym2_hyper)"
  ))

  bb_sp <- INLA::inla(
    bb_bym2_formula,
    family="betabinomial",
    Ntrials=model_dat$Total_tick,
    data=sp_dat,
    control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE,link=1),
    verbose=FALSE
  )

  oof$BetaBinomial_BYM2[test_idx] <-
    clip01(bb_sp$summary.fitted.values$mean[test_idx])

  spatial_diag[[length(spatial_diag)+1]] <- data.frame(
    Model="BetaBinomial_BYM2",Fold=f,
    BYM2_phi=get_hyper(bb_sp,"Phi"),
    BYM2_precision=get_hyper(bb_sp,"Precision"),
    Overdispersion=get_hyper(bb_sp,"overdispersion"),
    Base_slope=NA_real_
  )

  ## Random Forest: inner cross-fitted predictions for spatial calibration
  rf_par <- tune_rf[[f]]
  rf_train_pred <- rep(NA_real_,nrow(train))

  for(gf in sort(unique(train$spatial_fold))){

    it <- train %>% filter(spatial_fold != gf)
    iv <- train %>% filter(spatial_fold == gf)
    iv_idx <- which(train$spatial_fold == gf)

    rf_i <- ranger::ranger(
      dependent.variable.name="LS_prop",
      data=it[,c("LS_prop",final_vars)],
      case.weights=it$Total_tick/mean(it$Total_tick),
      num.trees=1000,
      mtry=rf_par$mtry,
      min.node.size=rf_par$min_node_size,
      seed=123+f+gf
    )

    rf_train_pred[iv_idx] <-
      predict(rf_i,data=iv[,final_vars])$predictions
  }

  rf_base <- rep(NA_real_,nrow(model_dat))
  rf_base[train_idx] <- rf_train_pred
  rf_base[test_idx] <- oof$RandomForest[test_idx]

  rf_sp_dat <- model_dat
  rf_sp_dat$y <- model_dat$LS_tick
  rf_sp_dat$y[test_idx] <- NA
  rf_sp_dat$sp_id <- seq_len(nrow(model_dat))
  rf_sp_dat$base_logit <- logit01(rf_base)

  hybrid_formula <- y ~ base_logit +
    f(sp_id,model="bym2",graph=g,scale.model=TRUE,
      constr=TRUE,hyper=bym2_hyper)

  rf_sp <- INLA::inla(
    hybrid_formula,
    family="betabinomial",
    Ntrials=model_dat$Total_tick,
    data=rf_sp_dat,
    control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE,link=1),
    verbose=FALSE
  )

  oof$RandomForest_BYM2[test_idx] <-
    clip01(rf_sp$summary.fitted.values$mean[test_idx])

  spatial_diag[[length(spatial_diag)+1]] <- data.frame(
    Model="RandomForest_BYM2",Fold=f,
    BYM2_phi=get_hyper(rf_sp,"Phi"),
    BYM2_precision=get_hyper(rf_sp,"Precision"),
    Overdispersion=get_hyper(rf_sp,"overdispersion"),
    Base_slope=rf_sp$summary.fixed["base_logit","mean"]
  )

  ## XGBoost: inner cross-fitted predictions for spatial calibration
  xgb_par <- tune_xgb[[f]]
  xgb_train_pred <- rep(NA_real_,nrow(train))

  for(gf in sort(unique(train$spatial_fold))){

    it <- train %>% filter(spatial_fold != gf)
    iv <- train %>% filter(spatial_fold == gf)
    iv_idx <- which(train$spatial_fold == gf)

    d_it <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(
      as.matrix(it[,final_vars]),
      label=it$LS_prop,
      weight=it$Total_tick/mean(it$Total_tick)
    )

    d_iv <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(iv[,final_vars]))

    xgb_i <- xgboost::xgb.train(
      params=list(
        objective="reg:squarederror",
        eval_metric="rmse",
        max_depth=xgb_par$max_depth,
        eta=xgb_par$eta,
        min_child_weight=xgb_par$min_child_weight,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8
      ),
      data=d_it,
      nrounds=xgb_par$nrounds,
      verbose=0
    )

    xgb_train_pred[iv_idx] <-
      clip01(predict(xgb_i,d_iv))
  }

  xgb_base <- rep(NA_real_,nrow(model_dat))
  xgb_base[train_idx] <- xgb_train_pred
  xgb_base[test_idx] <- oof$XGBoost[test_idx]

  xgb_sp_dat <- model_dat
  xgb_sp_dat$y <- model_dat$LS_tick
  xgb_sp_dat$y[test_idx] <- NA
  xgb_sp_dat$sp_id <- seq_len(nrow(model_dat))
  xgb_sp_dat$base_logit <- logit01(xgb_base)

  xgb_sp <- INLA::inla(
    hybrid_formula,
    family="betabinomial",
    Ntrials=model_dat$Total_tick,
    data=xgb_sp_dat,
    control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE,link=1),
    verbose=FALSE
  )

  oof$XGBoost_BYM2[test_idx] <-
    clip01(xgb_sp$summary.fitted.values$mean[test_idx])

  spatial_diag[[length(spatial_diag)+1]] <- data.frame(
    Model="XGBoost_BYM2",Fold=f,
    BYM2_phi=get_hyper(xgb_sp,"Phi"),
    BYM2_precision=get_hyper(xgb_sp,"Precision"),
    Overdispersion=get_hyper(xgb_sp,"overdispersion"),
    Base_slope=xgb_sp$summary.fixed["base_logit","mean"]
  )

  cat("Spatial fold",f,"complete\n")
}

spatial_diagnostics <- bind_rows(spatial_diag)

## Check spatial OOF predictions
spatial_models <- c(
  "BetaBinomial_BYM2",
  "RandomForest_BYM2",
  "XGBoost_BYM2"
)

print(colSums(is.na(oof[,spatial_models])))
print(spatial_diagnostics)

stopifnot(!anyNA(oof[,spatial_models]))

```


## SAVE OUTPUTS again including spatial BYM2 MODLES
```{r}
## Complete diagnostics for all 8 models + BYM2 diagnostics in one CSV
library(dplyr)
library(spdep)

## Eight models
models8 <- c(
  "BetaBinomial",
  "ElasticNet",
  "GAM",
  "RandomForest",
  "XGBoost",
  "BetaBinomial_BYM2",
  "RandomForest_BYM2",
  "XGBoost_BYM2"
)

## Check all OOF predictions exist
print(colSums(is.na(oof[,models8])))
stopifnot(!anyNA(oof[,models8]))

## Overall predictive performance and calibration
overall_8 <- bind_rows(lapply(models8,function(m){

  cal <- lm(oof$LS_prop ~ oof[[m]])

  data.frame(
    Model=m,
    Level="Overall",
    Fold=NA_integer_,
    RMSE=sqrt(mean((oof$LS_prop-oof[[m]])^2)),
    MAE=mean(abs(oof$LS_prop-oof[[m]])),
    R2=1-sum((oof$LS_prop-oof[[m]])^2)/
         sum((oof$LS_prop-mean(oof$LS_prop))^2),
    Spearman=cor(oof$LS_prop,oof[[m]],method="spearman"),
    Calibration_intercept=unname(coef(cal)[1]),
    Calibration_slope=unname(coef(cal)[2])
  )
}))

## Fold-level predictive performance and calibration
fold_8 <- bind_rows(lapply(models8,function(m){

  bind_rows(lapply(sort(unique(oof$spatial_fold)),function(f){

    d <- oof %>% filter(spatial_fold==f)
    cal <- lm(d$LS_prop ~ d[[m]])

    data.frame(
      Model=m,
      Level="Fold",
      Fold=f,
      RMSE=sqrt(mean((d$LS_prop-d[[m]])^2)),
      MAE=mean(abs(d$LS_prop-d[[m]])),
      R2=1-sum((d$LS_prop-d[[m]])^2)/
           sum((d$LS_prop-mean(d$LS_prop))^2),
      Spearman=cor(d$LS_prop,d[[m]],method="spearman"),
      Calibration_intercept=unname(coef(cal)[1]),
      Calibration_slope=unname(coef(cal)[2])
    )
  }))
}))

## Fold-to-fold consistency
fold_consistency_8 <- fold_8 %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    Fold_RMSE_SD=sd(RMSE),
    Worst_fold_RMSE=max(RMSE),
    Fold_MAE_SD=sd(MAE),
    .groups="drop"
  )

## Moran's I of OOF residuals
dat_moran <- dat[match(oof$CO_FIPS,dat$CO_FIPS),]
stopifnot(all(dat_moran$CO_FIPS==oof$CO_FIPS))

nb_moran <- spdep::poly2nb(dat_moran,queen=TRUE)
lw_moran <- spdep::nb2listw(nb_moran,style="W",zero.policy=TRUE)

moran_8 <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(models8),function(i){

  m <- models8[i]
  res <- oof$LS_prop-oof[[m]]

  set.seed(123+i)

  mc <- spdep::moran.mc(
    res,lw_moran,
    nsim=999,
    alternative="greater",
    zero.policy=TRUE
  )

  data.frame(
    Model=m,
    Moran_I=unname(mc$statistic),
    Moran_p=mc$p.value
  )
}))

## Add overall diagnostics to overall rows
overall_8 <- overall_8 %>%
  left_join(moran_8,by="Model") %>%
  left_join(fold_consistency_8,by="Model")

## Add empty overall-only fields to fold rows
fold_8 <- fold_8 %>%
  mutate(
    Moran_I=NA_real_,
    Moran_p=NA_real_,
    Fold_RMSE_SD=NA_real_,
    Worst_fold_RMSE=NA_real_,
    Fold_MAE_SD=NA_real_
  )

## Combine all 8 models
model_selection_8 <- bind_rows(overall_8,fold_8)

## BYM2 diagnostics for each spatial fold
bym2_fold_diag <- spatial_diagnostics %>%
  select(
    Model,Fold,
    BYM2_phi,
    BYM2_precision,
    Overdispersion,
    Base_slope
  )

## Mean BYM2 diagnostics across outer folds for overall rows
bym2_overall_diag <- spatial_diagnostics %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    BYM2_phi=mean(BYM2_phi,na.rm=TRUE),
    BYM2_precision=mean(BYM2_precision,na.rm=TRUE),
    Overdispersion=mean(Overdispersion,na.rm=TRUE),
    Base_slope=if(all(is.na(Base_slope))) NA_real_ else mean(Base_slope,na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups="drop"
  )

## Add BYM2 diagnostics to fold rows
model_selection_master <- model_selection_8 %>%
  left_join(
    bym2_fold_diag,
    by=c("Model","Fold")
  )

## Fill BYM2 overall rows with mean diagnostics across folds
for(i in seq_len(nrow(bym2_overall_diag))){

  m <- bym2_overall_diag$Model[i]
  idx <- model_selection_master$Model==m &
         model_selection_master$Level=="Overall"

  model_selection_master$BYM2_phi[idx] <-
    bym2_overall_diag$BYM2_phi[i]

  model_selection_master$BYM2_precision[idx] <-
    bym2_overall_diag$BYM2_precision[i]

  model_selection_master$Overdispersion[idx] <-
    bym2_overall_diag$Overdispersion[i]

  model_selection_master$Base_slope[idx] <-
    bym2_overall_diag$Base_slope[i]
}

## Arrange models and rows
model_selection_master$Model <- factor(
  model_selection_master$Model,
  levels=models8
)

model_selection_master <- model_selection_master %>%
  mutate(Level=factor(Level,levels=c("Overall","Fold"))) %>%
  arrange(Model,Level,Fold) %>%
  mutate(
    Model=as.character(Model),
    Level=as.character(Level)
  )

## Print final table
print(model_selection_master)

## Save ONE master CSV
out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Output"
dir.create(out_dir,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)

write.csv(
  model_selection_master,
  file.path(out_dir,"ML_8model_complete_diagnostics.csv"),
  row.names=FALSE
)

cat(
  "Saved:\n",
  file.path(out_dir,"ML_8model_complete_diagnostics.csv"),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r model-fitting, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
## Final RF and XGBoost models using all counties

## Combine spatial-CV tuning results
rf_tune <- dplyr::bind_rows(tune_rf)
xgb_tune <- dplyr::bind_rows(tune_xgb)

## Select most consistently chosen RF parameters
rf_final_par <- rf_tune %>%
  dplyr::group_by(mtry, min_node_size) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(N=dplyr::n(), Mean_RMSE=mean(inner_RMSE), .groups="drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(N), Mean_RMSE) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1)

## Select most consistently chosen XGBoost parameters
xgb_final_par <- xgb_tune %>%
  dplyr::group_by(max_depth, eta, min_child_weight) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(N=dplyr::n(), Mean_RMSE=mean(inner_RMSE),
                   nrounds=round(median(nrounds)), .groups="drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(N), Mean_RMSE) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1)

print(rf_final_par)
print(xgb_final_par)

## Final Random Forest
rf_final <- ranger::ranger(
  dependent.variable.name="LS_prop",
  data=model_dat[,c("LS_prop",final_vars)],
  case.weights=model_dat$Total_tick/mean(model_dat$Total_tick),
  num.trees=1000, mtry=rf_final_par$mtry,
  min.node.size=rf_final_par$min_node_size,
  importance="permutation", seed=123
)

              min_child_weight=xgb_final_par$min_child_weight,
```

## ALE plots   [ALE (Accumulated Local Effects) = What happens to predicted lone-star proportion as a predictor changes?]
```{r}
library(iml)

## ALE effects for top predictors
library(iml); library(ggplot2); library(dplyr)

X <- model_dat[,final_vars]; y <- model_dat$LS_prop
top_vars <- c("BIO2","BIO9","BIO8","Deer_suitability")

rf_pred <- iml::Predictor$new(
  model=rf_final, data=X, y=y,
  predict.function=function(model,newdata) predict(model,data=newdata)$predictions
)

xgb_pred <- iml::Predictor$new(
  model=xgb_final, data=X, y=y,
  predict.function=function(model,newdata) predict(model,as.matrix(newdata))
)

get_ale <- function(pred,v,model){
  a <- iml::FeatureEffect$new(pred,feature=v,method="ale",grid.size=20)$results
  data.frame(Model=model,Predictor=v,X=a[[v]],ALE=a$.value)
}

ale_dat <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(top_vars,function(v) get_ale(rf_pred,v,"Random Forest")),
  lapply(top_vars,function(v) get_ale(xgb_pred,v,"XGBoost"))
)

ale_dat$Predictor <- factor(
  ale_dat$Predictor,
  levels=top_vars,
  labels=c("Mean diurnal range","Temperature of driest quarter",
           "Temperature of wettest quarter","Deer suitability")
)


## Compact ALE: 4 panels, both models together
library(ggplot2)

p_ale <- ggplot(
  ale_dat,
  aes(x = X, y = ALE, color = Model, linetype = Model)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~Predictor, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Random Forest" = "#2171A5",
    "XGBoost" = "#D95F02"
  )) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
    "Random Forest" = "solid",
    "XGBoost" = "longdash"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "Predictor value",
    y = "ALE effect on predicted tick proportion",
    color = NULL,
    linetype = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
  axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
  axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
  axis.text.x  = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
  axis.text.y  = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),

  strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),

  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
  legend.box = "horizontal"
)

p_ale
```

```{r}
## LEFT PANEL = Random Forest

p_shap_rf_comb <- shapviz::sv_importance(sv_rf, kind = "beeswarm", max_display = 8) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    limits = rev(feature_order),
    labels = shap_labels,
    position = "right"
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Feature value") +
  labs(
    title = "Random Forest",
    x = "SHAP value",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_gray(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey94", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),

    ## hide left side y-axis completely
    axis.text.y.left = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y.left = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y.left = element_blank(),

    ## show right side y-axis clearly
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", color = "black", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.y.right = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.y.right = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),

    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  )

## RIGHT PANEL = XGBoost
p_shap_xgb_comb <- shapviz::sv_importance(sv_xgb, kind = "beeswarm", max_display = 8) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    limits = rev(feature_order),
    labels = shap_labels
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Feature value") +
  labs(
    title = "XGBoost",
    x = "SHAP value",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_gray(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey94", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),

    ## remove y-axis on right plot
    ## Hide feature names but retain the left y-axis
    axis.text.y.left = element_blank(),
    
    ## Show vertical y-axis line and small protruding ticks
    axis.line.y.left = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks.y.left = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks.length.y.left = grid::unit(4, "pt"),

    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 12)
  )

## Combine
p_shap_both <- p_shap_rf_comb + p_shap_xgb_comb +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect", widths = c(1, 1)) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_shap_both

## Save
out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Output"

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "RF_XGBoost_SHAP_beeswarm_combined_centerlabels.tiff"),
  p_shap_both,
  width = 13.5, height = 6.5, units = "in",
  dpi = 300, compression = "lzw", bg = "white"
)
```

### Top 50% ranking performance
```{r}
## Top 51 county ranking performance
top_n <- 51; n_counties <- nrow(oof)
rank_cut <- 1-(top_n-1)/(n_counties-1)

rank51 <- oof %>%
  dplyr::select(COUNTY_NAM, LS_prop, RandomForest, XGBoost) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Observed_rank=rank(-LS_prop,ties.method="first"),
                Observed_top51=Observed_rank<=top_n) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(RandomForest,XGBoost),names_to="Model",values_to="Predicted") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Model) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Predicted_rank=rank(-Predicted,ties.method="first"),
                Predicted_top51=Predicted_rank<=top_n,
                Correct_top51=Observed_top51 & Predicted_top51,
                Observed_pct=1-(Observed_rank-1)/(n_counties-1),
                Predicted_pct=1-(Predicted_rank-1)/(n_counties-1)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Model=dplyr::recode(Model,RandomForest="Random Forest",XGBoost="XGBoost"))

## Top-51 overlap
top51_summary <- rank51 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Model) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Correctly_identified=sum(Correct_top51),
    Top51_accuracy=100*Correctly_identified/51,
    Jaccard=Correctly_identified/sum(Observed_top51 | Predicted_top51),
    .groups="drop"
  )

print(top51_summary)

## Top-51 ranking plot
p_rank51 <- ggplot(rank51,aes(Observed_pct,Predicted_pct)) +
  geom_abline(intercept=0,slope=1,linetype="dashed",linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=rank_cut,linetype="dotted",linewidth=0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=rank_cut,linetype="dotted",linewidth=0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(shape=Correct_top51),size=2.2,alpha=0.75) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(`TRUE`=17,`FALSE`=16),
                     labels=c(`TRUE`="Correctly identified top 51",
                              `FALSE`="Other counties"),name=NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~Model) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,1),breaks=seq(0,1,0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,1),breaks=seq(0,1,0.2)) +
  labs(x="Observed percentile rank",y="Predicted percentile rank") +
  theme_classic(base_size=12) +
  theme(axis.title=element_text(face="bold"),
        strip.text=element_text(face="bold",size=12),
        legend.position="bottom")

p_rank51


## Top-51 recovery plot
p_top51 <- ggplot(top51_summary,
                  aes(x=Model, y=Top51_accuracy)) +
  geom_col(width=0.55) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label=paste0(Correctly_identified,"/51 (",
                     sprintf("%.1f",Top51_accuracy),"%)")),
    vjust=-0.5, fontface="bold", size=4
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits=c(0,100),
    breaks=seq(0,100,20),
    expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.06))
  ) +
  labs(
    x=NULL,
    y="Observed top-51 counties correctly identified (%)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size=12) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y=element_text(face="bold",size=12),
    axis.text.x=element_text(face="bold",size=12,color="black"),
    axis.text.y=element_text(color="black")
  )

p_top51


## Save top-51 recovery plot
out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Output"

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir,"RF_XGBoost_top51_recovery.tiff"),
  p_top51,
  width=6, height=5, units="in",
  dpi=300, compression="lzw", bg="white"
)
```

```{r}
## Rank-group agreement heatmap
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)

rank_group <- oof %>%
  dplyr::select(COUNTY_NAM, LS_prop, RandomForest, XGBoost) %>%
  mutate(Observed_rank=rank(-LS_prop,ties.method="average"),
         Observed_group=pmin(5,ceiling(Observed_rank/(n()/5)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(RandomForest,XGBoost),names_to="Model",values_to="Predicted") %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  mutate(Predicted_rank=rank(-Predicted,ties.method="average"),
         Predicted_group=pmin(5,ceiling(Predicted_rank/(n()/5)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Model=recode(Model,RandomForest="Random Forest",XGBoost="XGBoost"),
         Observed_group=factor(Observed_group,levels=1:5,
           labels=c("Highest 20%","High","Middle","Low","Lowest 20%")),
         Predicted_group=factor(Predicted_group,levels=1:5,
           labels=c("Highest 20%","High","Middle","Low","Lowest 20%")))

heat_dat <- rank_group %>%
  count(Model,Observed_group,Predicted_group,name="Count")

p_rank_heat <- ggplot(heat_dat,aes(Observed_group,Predicted_group,fill=Count)) +
  geom_tile(color="white",linewidth=1) +
  geom_text(aes(label=Count),fontface="bold",size=4) +
  facet_wrap(~Model) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option="plasma",name="Counties") +
  labs(x="Observed rank group",y="Predicted rank group") +
  theme_classic(base_size=12) +
  theme(
    axis.title=element_text(face="bold",size=12),
    axis.text.x=element_text(angle=35,hjust=1,color="black"),
    axis.text.y=element_text(color="black"),
    strip.text=element_text(face="bold",size=12)
  )

p_rank_heat

## Save rank-group heatmap
```

## Weighting sensitivity analysis: 50:50, 60:40, 70:30, 80:20
```{r}

## Weighting sensitivity including WUI (70:20:10)
library(dplyr); library(ggplot2)

d <- sf::st_drop_geometry(ags_sensitivity) %>%
  mutate(COUNTY_KEY=toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]","",COUNTY_NAM))) %>%
  left_join(ags_val %>% distinct(COUNTY_KEY,.keep_all=TRUE) %>%
              select(COUNTY_KEY,AGS_ord),by="COUNTY_KEY")

stopifnot(nrow(d)==102, sum(!is.na(d$AGS_ord))==97)

weights <- c(.50,.60,.70,.80)
labels <- c("50:50","60:40","70:30","80:20","70:20:10 WUI")

calculate <- function(pred,model) {
  scores <- cbind(
    sapply(weights,function(w) w*pred+(1-w)*d$Eh_scaled),
    .70*pred+.20*d$Eh_scaled+.10*d$WUI_population_prop
  )
  colnames(scores) <- labels

  ## Correlations between indices: 102 counties
  internal <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor(scores,method="spearman")))
  names(internal) <- c("Scenario","Compared_with","Rho")
  internal <- internal %>% mutate(Model=model,Comparison="Between indices",N=102)

  ## Correlations with CDC categories: 97 counties
  valid <- !is.na(d$AGS_ord)
  external <- data.frame(
    Model=model,Comparison="CDC categories",Scenario=labels,
    Compared_with="CDC categories",N=sum(valid),
    Rho=as.vector(cor(scores[valid,,drop=FALSE],
                      d$AGS_ord[valid],method="spearman"))
  )
  bind_rows(internal,external)
}

results <- bind_rows(
  calculate(d$RandomForest,"Random Forest"),
  calculate(d$XGBoost,"XGBoost")
)

print(results)
write.csv(results,file.path(out_dir,"AGS_weighting_sensitivity_comparison.csv"),
          row.names=FALSE)

## Figure S7: Five-scenario internal correlation heatmaps
plotdat <- results %>%
  filter(Comparison=="Between indices") %>%
  mutate(Scenario=factor(Scenario,levels=labels),
         Compared_with=factor(Compared_with,levels=rev(labels)))

p <- ggplot(plotdat,aes(Scenario,Compared_with,fill=Rho)) +
  geom_tile(color="white",linewidth=0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%.3f",Rho),
              color=Rho >= 0.99),
          size=3.7, fontface="bold") +
scale_color_manual(
  values=c("TRUE"="black","FALSE"="white"),
  guide="none"
) +
  facet_wrap(~Model,nrow=1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
  option = "D",
  limits = c(0.95, 1),
  name = "Spearman rank correlation (ρ)"
) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x="AGS index weighting scenario",y=NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size=12) +
  theme(strip.text=element_text(face="bold",size=13),
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=35,hjust=1,face="bold"),
        axis.text.y=element_text(face="bold"),
        axis.title.x=element_text(face="bold"))

p <- p +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
    direction = "vertical",
    barheight = grid::unit(10, "cm"),
    barwidth = grid::unit(0.45, "cm"),
    title.position = "right",
    title.theme = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1,
                               face = "plain", color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "plain", color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
ggsave(file.path(out_dir,"Figure_S7_weighting_WUI_correlations.tiff"),
       p,width=10,height=5,units="in",
       dpi=600,compression="lzw",bg="white")
```

```{r}
## Number of counties in each AGS category
table(ags_test$AGS_group)

## Spearman correlation + bootstrap 95% CI
set.seed(123); B <- 5000

spearman_ci <- function(y,x,B=5000){
  n <- length(y)
  rb <- replicate(B,{
    i <- sample.int(n,n,replace=TRUE)
    cor(y[i],x[i],method="spearman")
  })

  data.frame(
    rho=cor(y,x,method="spearman"),
    CI_low=unname(quantile(rb,0.025,na.rm=TRUE)),
    CI_high=unname(quantile(rb,0.975,na.rm=TRUE)),
    p=cor.test(y,x,method="spearman",exact=FALSE)$p.value
  )
}

## Validation correlations

  cbind(Index="Random Forest primary",
        spearman_ci(ags_test$AGS_ord,ags_test$RF_AGS_index,B)),
  cbind(Index="XGBoost primary",
        spearman_ci(ags_test$AGS_ord,ags_test$XGB_AGS_index,B)),
  cbind(Index="Random Forest sensitivity",
        spearman_ci(ags_test$AGS_ord,ags_test$RF_AGS_sensitivity,B)),
  cbind(Index="XGBoost sensitivity",
```

```{r}
m_xgb_sens_np <- clm(AGS_ord_factor~1,nominal=~I(XGB_AGS_sensitivity*10),data=ags_test,link="logit")

## Extract threshold-specific ORs per 0.10 increase
get_np_or <- function(model,name,analysis){
  b <- coef(summary(model)); rn <- rownames(b)
  keep <- !grepl("\\(Intercept\\)",rn)
  b <- b[keep,,drop=FALSE]; rn <- rn[keep]
  data.frame(Analysis=analysis,Model=name,Threshold=sub("\\..*$","",rn),
             OR_per_0.10=exp(-b[,"Estimate"]),
             CI_low=exp(-(b[,"Estimate"]+1.96*b[,"Std. Error"])),
             CI_high=exp(-(b[,"Estimate"]-1.96*b[,"Std. Error"])),
             p=2*pnorm(-abs(b[,"z value"])),row.names=NULL)
}

np_results <- bind_rows(
  get_np_or(m_rf_np,"Random Forest","Primary"),
  get_np_or(m_xgb_np,"XGBoost","Primary"),
  get_np_or(m_rf_sens_np,"Random Forest","Sensitivity"),
  get_np_or(m_xgb_sens_np,"XGBoost","Sensitivity")
)

## Function to generate predicted probabilities
make_prob <- function(model,var,x,name){
  nd <- data.frame(x)
  names(nd) <- var
  pr <- as.data.frame(predict(model,newdata=nd,type="prob")$fit)

  cbind(AGS_index=x,pr) %>%
    pivot_longer(-AGS_index,names_to="CDC_category",values_to="Probability") %>%
    mutate(Model=name)
}
```

##Print and export threshold-specific ORs from non-proportional models

```{r}
## Print and export threshold-specific ORs from non-proportional models
get_np_or <- function(model,name,analysis){
  s <- coef(summary(model))
  s <- s[grepl("I\\(",rownames(s)),,drop=FALSE]

  threshold_clean <- case_when(
  grepl("^0\\|<11",rownames(s)) ~ "0 vs >0",
  grepl("^<11\\|11",rownames(s)) ~ "0/<11 vs 11-87/>87",
  grepl("^11",rownames(s)) ~ "0/<11/11-87 vs >87",
  TRUE ~ rownames(s)
)
  data.frame(
    Analysis=analysis,
    Model=name,
    Threshold=threshold_clean,
    OR_per_0.10=exp(-s[,"Estimate"]),
    CI_low=exp(-(s[,"Estimate"]+1.96*s[,"Std. Error"])),
    CI_high=exp(-(s[,"Estimate"]-1.96*s[,"Std. Error"])),
    p_value=2*pnorm(-abs(s[,"z value"])),
    row.names=NULL
  )
}

np_results <- bind_rows(
  get_np_or(m_rf_np,"Random Forest","Primary"),
  get_np_or(m_xgb_np,"XGBoost","Primary"),
  get_np_or(m_rf_sens_np,"Random Forest","Sensitivity"),
  get_np_or(m_xgb_sens_np,"XGBoost","Sensitivity")
)

print(np_results)
```

## Spatial averaging: 50% focal county + 50% adjacent counties
```{r}
## Spatial averaging: 50% focal county + 50% adjacent counties
library(sf); library(spdep); library(dplyr)

risk_sf <- st_make_valid(ags_sensitivity)
nb <- poly2nb(risk_sf,queen=TRUE)

indices <- c("RF_AGS_index","XGB_AGS_index",
             "RF_AGS_sensitivity","XGB_AGS_sensitivity")

stopifnot(!anyNA(st_drop_geometry(risk_sf)[indices]))

for(v in indices){
  x <- risk_sf[[v]]
  risk_sf[[paste0(v,"_sp50")]] <- vapply(seq_along(nb),function(i){
    neighbors <- nb[[i]]
    if(length(neighbors)==1 && neighbors[1]==0) return(x[i])
    0.50*x[i]+0.50*mean(x[neighbors])
  },numeric(1))
}

## Join CDC AGS categories and compare correlations
ags_spatial <- ags_val %>%
  select(COUNTY_NAM,AGS_ord) %>%
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(risk_sf) %>%
              select(COUNTY_NAM,all_of(c(indices,paste0(indices,"_sp50")))),
            by="COUNTY_NAM") %>%
  filter(!is.na(AGS_ord))

spatial_results <- bind_rows(lapply(indices,function(v){
  original <- cor.test(ags_spatial[[v]],ags_spatial$AGS_ord,method="spearman",exact=FALSE)
  smooth <- cor.test(ags_spatial[[paste0(v,"_sp50")]],ags_spatial$AGS_ord,
                     method="spearman",exact=FALSE)

  data.frame(
    Index=v,
    N=nrow(ags_spatial),
    Original_rho=unname(original$estimate),
    Spatial50_rho=unname(smooth$estimate),
    Change_rho=unname(smooth$estimate-original$estimate),
    Original_p=original$p.value,
    Spatial50_p=smooth$p.value
  )
}))

print(spatial_results)

## Export comparison and county-level indices
out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Output"

write.csv(spatial_results,file.path(out_dir,"CDC_AGS_spatial_50_50_correlation_comparison.csv"),row.names=FALSE)


## Plot original vs spatially averaged AGS correlations
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)

plot_data <- spatial_results %>%
  mutate(
    Analysis=if_else(grepl("sensitivity$",Index),"Sensitivity","Primary"),
    Model=if_else(grepl("^RF_",Index),"Random Forest","XGBoost"),
    Analysis=factor(Analysis,levels=c("Primary","Sensitivity")),
    Model=factor(Model,levels=c("Random Forest","XGBoost"))
  )

plot_long <- plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Original_rho,Spatial50_rho),names_to="Version",values_to="Rho") %>%
  mutate(Version=factor(Version,levels=c("Original_rho","Spatial50_rho"),
                        labels=c("Original","Spatially averaged")))

## Publication-quality comparison plot
p_spatial <- ggplot(plot_long,aes(Model,Rho,fill=Version)) +
  geom_col(position=position_dodge(width=0.75),width=0.65,color="white",linewidth=0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%.3f",Rho)),
            position=position_dodge(width=0.75),vjust=-0.5,
            size=3.8,fontface="bold",color="#263238") +
  geom_text(data=plot_data,
            aes(x=Model,y=0.87,label=sprintf("\u0394\u03c1 = +%.3f",Change_rho)),
            inherit.aes=FALSE,size=3.7,fontface="bold",color="#087F8C") +
  facet_wrap(~Analysis,nrow=1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("Original"="#263B59",
                             "Spatially averaged"="#087F8C")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,0.94),breaks=seq(0,0.8,0.2),
                     expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0))) +
  labs(x=NULL,y="Spearman correlation (\u03c1)",
       fill=NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size=13) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y=element_text(face="bold",margin=margin(r=10)),
    axis.text=element_text(color="black"),
    axis.text.x=element_text(face="bold"),
    axis.line.y=element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y=element_line(color="#E5E9EE",linewidth=0.35),
    strip.text=element_text(face="bold",size=12),
    strip.background=element_rect(fill="#F0F2F5",color="#D8DDE3"),
    legend.position="top",
    legend.text=element_text(face="bold"),
    panel.spacing=unit(1.5,"lines")
  )

p_spatial

## Export TIFF (300 dpi)
```
